styleLock.direction: clear watery-pink glass-finish lip tint commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and inset wear crops, clear-water pink #F7DDE3 for the colour-change and step layouts, glassy pale aqua-white #E7F2F3 for macro and vanity scenes; the dewy rose #E5A6B4 is only ever a hairline rule, node circle or label pill outline, never a lip hue, because every tint value is carried by the accent placeholder
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key neutral studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, skimming sweep across the transparent bullet so its glass depth reads, butterfly light on skin crops, soft contact shadows only, controlled clean speculars on glass-like surfaces
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep plus clear-water pink matte boards #F7DDE3 and one polished pale glass counter #E7F2F3, no horizon line and no warm beige tabletop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only: one oversized headline, one thin sub-line and short step labels, all in-image copy supplied at generation time as placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline rules, blank rounded label pills and small circular step nodes outlined in dewy rose #E5A6B4, no filled illustrations and no tick or cross graphics
styleLock.presentationRules: one open square-column tube anchor reused at stable scale with the bullet always reading glass-clear, every lip crop taken from the nose down so no identity shows, and every lip tint hue carried by the accent placeholder instead of a fixed shade
noDrift: no fixed lip tint hue across the set
no warm cream, taupe or ash-brown surfaces anywhere in the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clear watery-pink lip tint visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, clear-water pink #F7DDE3, glassy pale aqua-white #E7F2F3 and one dewy rose accent #E5A6B4, with every lip tint hue carried by one accent placeholder; bright even high-key neutral studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, skimming sweep across the transparent bullet, butterfly light on skin crops, soft contact shadows and controlled clean speculars; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight hairline rules, blank rounded label pills and small circular step nodes; stable straight-on to slight 3/4 product anchor angle with the bullet always reading glass-clear; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：1 纯白底上一支方柱金管开盖立管，盖上旁立，膏体透明、内部悬浮细片；2 缎面底版，左侧开盖管身，右侧上下两格唇部特写（上格近裸色、下格转粉），顶部两行大字标题、底部一行小字说明「最终颜色随唇部温度与湿度而异」；3 象牙底版带虚化光斑，主体为一支斜向仰角透明膏体大微距（内含细片），右侧一小支完整开盖管身，顶部标题加一行小字；4 顶部两行标题，左侧开盖管身，右侧自鼻部裁切的唇部大特写（水光转粉），下方台面上一条抹开的透明色带；5 顶部两行标题，左侧立管与旁盖，中间并排三格同机位唇部特写由浅到深递进，格间两枚圆形箭头节点，底边一条薄纱状透明带，右下一行小字；6 顶部一行标题，其下三张竖版流程卡各带圆形编号与两行步骤短句（上唇、等待显色、按需补涂），卡内为鼻下唇部特写，卡下另有开盖管身与一枚圆形小镜；7 顶部一行标题加一行小字，左侧梳妆台面立管与旁盖、圆形小镜与后方虚化玻璃瓶与花，右侧圆角插版面袋内躺盖好的管身与一枚粉盒。分镜处理：源图无痛点页，未新增痛点镜；2 与 5 均为同机位唇部排格但构图与主张不同（双栏涂前涂后 vs 三格渐进显色），各保留一镜；3 透明膏体微距独立成 DETAIL；4 的润泽主张与 6 的步骤流程、7 的随身场景各自独立；另按漏斗补一镜内含物空白标贴收口，共 8 镜，首镜 HERO、末镜 TRUST。品类判定：全部图像围绕一支上唇后转色的着色润唇膏的透明膏体、上唇显色妆效与补妆场景展开，属着色彩妆而非护理清洁，故判美妆彩妆/唇部（护肤个护 L2 内亦无唇部护理项，进一步支持该判定）。已剥离：原品牌字标与管身字样、原图英文文案原句（含显色与保湿舒适一类断言与「因人而异」免责小字）、模特面容与身份、原平台角标与店铺字样，一律改为 {product} 占位、{selling_point_n} 与 {callout_n} 占位、空白标签位与未印组件；温感转色深浅、透明质地、随身便携等只保留可拍摄的视觉状态，不写任何时长、持色、含水量、成分浓度与检测数值；全部唇色与试色色相一律由 {accent_color} 承载，不锁死具体色号色值；人物仅保留自鼻部裁掉的匿名下半脸，无眼无全脸。色板与背景体系改为清水粉 #F7DDE3、底白 #FFFFFF、玻璃浅青白 #E7F2F3 与水光玫强调 #E5A6B4 的透明玻璃水感体系，避开雾紫、藕灰与奶油棕暖调台面，与库内既有四套唇部模版区分。
